lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
notifications-settings: 448 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/browser-storage 448 B.
All 3 pages load the same 2 files: 90,869 B raw, 34,223 B gzip, 95.2 % of the smallest page (notifications-main, 95,469 B).
Inside: @vue/runtime-core 43,973 B, @vue/reactivity 17,438 B, @vue/runtime-dom 13,565 B, @vue/shared 3,478 B, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 28 B.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,440 B on the notifications-settings page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (103 packages, 373 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
